setPiece.place: Shattered freight lane around the fractured Bourse carrier wreck. Helios-adjacent wreck field, not a mining claim.
setPiece.twist: The spindle's inertia is twice the manifest. Hitch it and the spool lies. Then scavengers, an official tug, and a civilian pod all claim the same line.

solutions.how: Attach and reel the sealed spindle. Player leftover capability massline.attach. First hitch is leftover beat stabilize_spindle.
Cut the spindle line and reanchor to the civilian pod. Player leftover capability massline.cut. Leftover beat civilian_pod_choice is rescue.priority plus cut-or-reanchor, not a menu.
